question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s consolidated authority within the Chinese Communist Party and People’s Liberation Army underpins the 95.8% trader consensus that he will remain in power through 2027. Ongoing military purges, including senior Central Military Commission figures in early 2026, have reinforced centralized control rather than signaling weakness, while preparations for the 21st Party Congress emphasize continuity and loyalty networks over leadership transition. No public statements or institutional signals point to an early exit, consistent with his prior extension of tenure norms. Remaining risks include abrupt health developments or elite realignments ahead of the congress, though the absence of visible challengers and procedural barriers make such shifts improbable in the near term.
